@rule2 cols foot
@obs body: the rules of the frame are printed heavy outside and thin inside; set as in the other tables. The print is slightly skewed (the left edge of the table leans about 1 pt to the left over its height).
@obs body L10: «2 30 25 44» is printed so, with 30 degrees (for 3 signs 0 degrees, as the increment of the column gives).
@obs body L5, L12, L16: specks are printed after the 8 of the mean motion (L5), below the 29 of the days (L12) and above the 17 of the minutes of the mean motion (L16); not transcribed.
